import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
PY=sys.executable; SUB="/app/submission/main.py"
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10,"packet_limit":5,"prefix_width":2,
     "rules":[{"id":7,"class":2,"priority":10,"ranges":[[100,105],[-60,-60]]}],
     "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":8},"gt":{"class":9}}}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    path=os.path.join(tmp,"p.json"); open(path,"wb").write(p.stdout)
    def stream(reqs):
        data=("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+"\n").encode()
        q=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        return q.returncode,[json.loads(x) for x in q.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
    # checkpoint with an empty (directionless) flow, restore, then send packets
    rc,out = stream([{"op":"open","flow":4,"time":0},{"op":"checkpoint"}])
    snap = out[1]["checkpoint"]
    print("checkpoint:", json.dumps(snap))
    rc,out2 = stream([{"op":"restore","checkpoint":snap},
                      {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":4,"time":1,"source":1,"length":102}]},
                      {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":4,"time":3,"source":0,"length":60}]},
                      {"op":"close","flow":4,"time":3}])
    print("restored run:", json.dumps(out2))
    assert out2[2]["events"] == [{"type":"match","flow":4,"rule":7,"start":0,"end":2},
                                  {"type":"decision","flow":4,"class":2,"reason":"key","at":2,"time":3,"rule":7}], out2[2]
    print("OK")
EOF
